dialogue.origin: （こんばんは。よろしくお願い致します。）
dialogue.content: (Good evening. It's a pleasure to speak with you.)

dialogue.origin: (こんばんは。よろしくお願い致します。ご希望のケースはございますか？)
dialogue.content: (Good evening. It's a pleasure to speak with you too. Do you have a specific case you'd like to work on?)

dialogue.origin: （お気遣いありがとうございます。今日は特にないのでお任せでお願いします。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for asking. I don't have anything specific in mind today, so I'll leave it up to you.)

dialogue.origin: (かしこまりました)
dialogue.content: (Certainly.)

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。相談員です。初めに年齢と性別と今日お話ししたいことを教えてください。
dialogue.content: Good evening. I'm a counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 36歳、女妊娠してしまい、困っています。
dialogue.content: I'm 36, female. I've become pregnant, and I'm in trouble.

dialogue.origin: お話してくださりありがとうございます。妊娠していて何がお困りなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me. What is it about being pregnant that's causing you trouble?

dialogue.origin: 旦那の子供じゃないので
dialogue.content: Because it's not my husband's child.

dialogue.origin: そのような状況なのですね。今は妊娠何か月目ですか？
dialogue.content: I see, so that's the situation. How many months pregnant are you now?

dialogue.origin: もうすぐ生まれるんじゃないかと思います
dialogue.content: I think the baby might be due soon.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。相談者さんの体調はいかがですか？
dialogue.content: I see. How are you feeling physically?

dialogue.origin: いつも寝てます
dialogue.content: I'm always sleeping.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。無理はしないようにしてくださいね。今は病院に通院はされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Please don't overdo it. Are you currently going to a hospital for prenatal care?

dialogue.origin: 病院へは行ってません
dialogue.content: I haven't been to a hospital.

dialogue.origin: お金無いし
dialogue.content: I don't have any money.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。まずは相談者さんのお身体とお子さんのお身体を考えるととりあえず病院へいかれた方がいいかと思います。
dialogue.content: I understand. First and foremost, considering your health and the baby's, I think it would be best to go to a hospital for now.

dialogue.origin: 診察代も出産代も払えないから行けません。
dialogue.content: I can't afford the consultation fees or the delivery costs, so I can't go.

dialogue.origin: バレずにお金もかけずに生む方法って、ありませんか？
dialogue.content: Isn't there a way to give birth without anyone finding out and without spending money?

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。こちらでは妊娠や出産に特化している相談窓口ではないので何とも言えないです。ただ、妊娠SOSというところがあってそちらだといろいろ話を聞いてもらえると思います。
dialogue.content: I understand. This isn't a support service that specializes in pregnancy and childbirth, so I can't say for sure. However, there's a service called "Pregnancy SOS," and I think they would be able to listen to your situation in detail.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。そしたらここで相談する必要ないですね。
dialogue.content: Oh, I see. Then there's no point in talking to you here, is there?

dialogue.origin: 場所を間違えたみたいで、すみませんでした。
dialogue.content: It seems I came to the wrong place. I'm sorry.

dialogue.origin: 妊娠や出産に関してのアドバイスはできないですが、相談者さんに寄り添えればと思っています。
dialogue.content: While I can't give advice specifically about pregnancy and childbirth, I hope I can be here to support you.

dialogue.origin: 今の状況を誰かに相談などはできていますか？
dialogue.content: Have you been able to talk to anyone about your current situation?

dialogue.origin: いいえ
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。一人で抱え込むにはしんどい問題だと思います。相談者さんのお考えとして誰にもバレず、お金をかけないで出産したいということでしたが、生まれたお子さんはどうしたいとお考えなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. This must be a very difficult issue to handle all on your own. You mentioned wanting to give birth without anyone finding out and without spending money, but what are your thoughts on what you'd like to do with the baby after it's born?

dialogue.origin: ネットで調べたら、特別養子縁組というのがあるそうで、それができたらと思っています。旦那にバレずに産んで、子供を望んでいるかたに育てて貰えたら、と。
dialogue.content: I looked it up online, and it seems there's something called a special adoption program. I'm hoping I can do that. To give birth without my husband finding out and have the child raised by someone who wants a baby.

dialogue.origin: お金無いから育てられないし
dialogue.content: I can't raise the child because I don't have money.

dialogue.origin: そうお考えなのですね。確かに夫さんにバレずに産んで特別要支援組にお子様を預ける方法もありますよね。
dialogue.content: So that's what you're thinking. It's true that there are ways to give birth without your husband finding out and place the child in a special adoption program.

dialogue.origin: 多分その方が、お腹の子にとっても幸せだと思います
dialogue.content: I think that would probably be happier for the baby as well.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。今相談者さんはお子さんのこれからのことも考えれているのですね。妊娠してしまった経緯というのはお話できますか？話せる範囲で大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.content: I see. So you are thinking about your child's future. Would you be able to tell me about the circumstances that led to your pregnancy? Only as much as you're comfortable sharing.

dialogue.origin: 2番目の子が生まれてから、旦那とあまり仲が良くなくて。バイト先で知り合った年下の子とそういう関係になって、妊娠しました。
dialogue.content: After our second child was born, my husband and I weren't getting along very well. I got into that kind of relationship with a younger person I met at my part-time job, and I got pregnant.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。その相手の方はこの状況は知らせているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Have you informed the other person about this situation?

dialogue.origin: 知らせたら音信不通になりました
dialogue.content: When I told him, he cut off contact.

dialogue.origin: 私も甘かったんですよね、生理不順だから大丈夫だろうと思ってたし
dialogue.content: I was naive, wasn't I? I thought it would be fine because my periods are irregular.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。音信不通になってしまって誰にも話せないと心細く不安になることもあると思います。
dialogue.content: I see. With him cutting off contact and you not being able to talk to anyone, I imagine you must feel helpless and anxious.

dialogue.origin: というか、ああやっぱりね、って感じでした
dialogue.content: Actually, it was more like, 'Ah, I figured as much.'

dialogue.origin: まさか妊娠してないだろうと思っているうちに、中絶もできなくなってしまいました
dialogue.content: While I was thinking, "Surely I'm not pregnant," it became too late to have an abortion.

dialogue.origin: そのように思われているのですね。
dialogue.content: So that's how you've been feeling.

dialogue.origin: 今の状況を相談者さんはどのようにお感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How do you feel about your current situation?

dialogue.origin: どうしようもないですよね、ここまできちゃうと
dialogue.content: There's nothing I can do now, is there? Now that it's come to this.

dialogue.origin: もうすぐ生まれてきてしまうという状況であればとりあえず出産をどうするかを考えられた方がいいかと思います。
dialogue.content: Given that the baby will be born soon, I think it would be best to first think about what to do for the delivery.

dialogue.origin: 病院へは行けないので、困ってますけど、それは別のところで相談しなきゃいけないんですよね？
dialogue.content: I can't go to a hospital, so I'm at a loss, but I have to consult somewhere else about that, right?

dialogue.origin: こんなこと相談されても困っちゃいますよね。すみません。
dialogue.content: You must be troubled being asked about this. I'm sorry.

dialogue.origin: 病院へ行けないというのは金銭的な面と誰にもバレたくないからでしょうか？
dialogue.content: When you say you can't go to the hospital, is it for financial reasons and because you don't want anyone to find out?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 旦那とまだ一緒に住んでるのに病院なんて行けませんよね
dialogue.content: I'm still living with my husband, so I can't just go to the hospital, can I?

dialogue.origin: ここでは相談者さんのお住まいの地域の詳しいことが分からないので具体的なアドバイスはできませんが、お住まいの保健所に相談してなるべく費用をかけずに秘密厳守のところをきいてみるのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I don't have detailed information about your local area, so I can't give specific advice. However, how about consulting your local public health center and asking about options that are low-cost and confidential?

dialogue.origin: ちょっと難しそうです病院行って出産したら、数日入院しなきゃいけませんよね旦那にバレないように毎日寝て誤魔化しているので
dialogue.content: That sounds a bit difficult. If I go to the hospital to give birth, I'll have to be hospitalized for a few days, right? I've been pretending to be asleep every day to hide it from my husband.

dialogue.origin: 色々調べてくださってるのに、すみません
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, even though you've been looking into various things for me.

dialogue.origin: 数日の入院も難しそうなのですね。夫さんにバレないのが最優先ということなのかなと聞いていて感じているのですが、ご両親など身近な人に相談して協力してもらうのはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So even a few days in the hospital seems difficult. It sounds like your top priority is not letting your husband find out. How about talking to someone close to you, like your parents, and asking for their help?

dialogue.origin: 親が聞いたらショックで立ち直れないと思います。今の状況は我ながら情けなくて、言えません。
dialogue.content: If my parents found out, I think they'd be so shocked they wouldn't recover. I feel so pathetic about my situation, I can't tell them.

dialogue.origin: なんでこんなことになっちゃったんだろう
dialogue.content: How did things end up like this...

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。両親に相談できなくても誰かに相談して協力をしてもらった方がいいかと思います。
dialogue.content: I see. Even if you can't talk to your parents, I think it would be best to talk to someone and get their help.

dialogue.origin: 思いもよらない妊娠にそう感じておられるのですね。
dialogue.content: It sounds like you're feeling that way because of this unexpected pregnancy.

dialogue.origin: お話の途中ですが、そろそろお時間になってきました。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry to interrupt, but our time is almost up.

dialogue.origin: わかりました
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 相談者さんの体も心配なので、今日お話しさせていただいたお近くの保健所か妊娠SOSに一度相談してしてみてください。
dialogue.content: I'm also concerned about your health, so please try consulting with your local public health center or the Pregnancy SOS service we talked about today.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: こちらでもお話を聞きたいと思っているのでいつでも相談に来てくださいね。
dialogue.content: We're here to listen as well, so please feel free to come back and talk anytime.

dialogue.origin: 今日は相談に来ていただきありがとうございました。これで相談を終了させていただきます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming to consult with us today. We'll end the session here.

dialogue.origin: (お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time and hard work. I appreciate it.)

dialogue.origin: （お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time as well. Thank you.)

topic.sub: 妊娠に関する秘密とその影響
